node.title: Re^7: Getting the client IP in Apache, version 2.4
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
But none of the remote_* or client_* methods seem to be defined for Apache2::Connection.

That sounds quite strange to me - but as I said, I'm not an expert on mod_perl anymore, maybe another Monk will know more if you post a new question. What version does [mod://Apache2::Connection] report? (i.e. $Apache2::Connection::VERSION)

Minor edits shortly after posting.
